stories.new_fact: The Justice Department asked Washington state to set aside ballots from more than 400 people it alleges registered without citizenship pending eligibility confirmation.
stories.new_takeaway: The immediate decision is procedural verification under state authority, not a conclusion from the allegation alone.
stories.why_now: The federal request was made Monday, one week before the general election.
stories.previous_coverage: No compared episode covered this Washington request.
stories.uncertainty: The available report does not resolve individual eligibility, state authority to follow the request, or a final court outcome.
stories.watch: State response, court filing, or documented verification process.

stories.new_fact: Franklin County reached 54,000 early in-person voters, more than 6,000 above its full 2022 early in-person total, with a week remaining.
stories.new_takeaway: The local implication is queue and deadline planning, not a forecast of the result.
stories.why_now: WOSU reported the weekend threshold and Monday line on October 26.
stories.previous_coverage: The prior seven scripts did not cover this local turnout count.
stories.uncertainty: Early voting does not determine final turnout, vote choice, party mix, or outcome.
stories.watch: County hours, mail-ballot-request deadline and official turnout updates.

stories.new_fact: FHFA scheduled its monthly August HPI release for October 27 at 9 a.m. Eastern; the preceding July report showed a 0.3% monthly and 2.6% annual national gain.
stories.new_takeaway: New price data informs valuation and pipeline monitoring but does not set property-level eligibility or mortgage-insurance cancellation.
stories.why_now: The release becomes available today, updating the conventional-mortgage market reference.
stories.previous_coverage: The recent mortgage segments covered a proposed mortgage-insurance workflow, not today’s FHFA data release.
stories.uncertainty: The August result was not available at the recorded cutoff; a broad repeat-sales index is not a property appraisal or program rule.
stories.watch: August national and regional direction, local series and any later enterprise policy response.

stories.new_fact: Bank of America, Citi, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone announced a $63 billion financing structure for Broadcom AI equipment to be leased to Anthropic, with expected deliveries beginning in 2027.
stories.new_takeaway: This is structured-finance and concentration evidence, not evidence of a bank AI workflow succeeding in production.
stories.why_now: The joint announcement was issued October 26.
stories.previous_coverage: The latest banking-AI segments discussed Santander’s service experiment and Bank of Ireland’s operations, not AI-infrastructure finance.
stories.uncertainty: No utilization, payment coverage, delivery, energy, collateral-value, loss-protection or operating-quality metric is disclosed.
stories.watch: Terms, draw timing, delivery milestones, demand commitments and bank exposure commentary.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Bank of America / Citi / Morgan Stanley / Blackstone — new lane-6 announced AI-compute structured-financing row; company claim, expected 2027 deliveries, no performance metric.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI made GPT-6.1 Terra available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, with stated visual reasoning and computer-use gains and lower pricing than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
stories.new_takeaway: The release makes offline, task-specific computer-use evaluation cheaper; it does not prove a regulated workflow is accurate or safe.
stories.previous_coverage: No compared episode discussed GPT-6.1 Terra.
stories.uncertainty: Benchmark and safety comparisons are lab-reported, and public data do not establish performance on bank systems, data, exceptions or customer consequences.
stories.watch: Independent replication, system-card detail and task-level evidence versus the prior model.

stories.new_fact: The Federal Reserve’s October 27-28 meeting starts today, with AP reporting investors see little chance of a hike this week after officials downplayed it.
stories.new_takeaway: The statement, dissents and December framing can move market pricing even if the policy rate is unchanged.
stories.why_now: The meeting begins today and decision arrives Wednesday.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous episode flagged the meeting but did not cover today’s opening and updated policy stakes.
stories.uncertainty: Market pricing can change and no decision or lender rate-sheet response had occurred at cutoff.
stories.watch: Wednesday statement, chair explanation, Treasury yields and lender rate sheets.
